purpose: Phase 1-2 integration, adversarial verification and closure

workers.task: Integrate the merged chat domain and storage contracts into a versioned RoomRepository abstraction with transactional save/load/list/delete, immutable snapshots, deterministic ordering, and recovery-safe errors. Add integration tests.

Implement the composer domain/controller with IME composition lifecycle lock, send eligibility, enter-to-send policy, draft state, attachment references as opaque IDs, and deterministic tests including Arabic composition sequences.

Integrate chat orchestration with provider streaming contracts into a cancellation-aware streaming session adapter. Ensure transient assistant drafts are finalized once and never committed twice. Add race tests.

Build an adversarial cancellation/race harness for the merged TaskManager + chat streaming layers: rapid stop/start, double stop, deadline vs user cancel, provider late chunks, room switch. Include reusable verification primitives and regression tests.

Implement provider execution service over merged provider contracts and TaskManager, with global deadlines, normalized errors, cancellation propagation, and strict final-message validation. Add fake-provider integration tests.

Implement immutable model registry/catalog primitives that normalize models from providers, track capabilities and availability, support deterministic strongest-first policy inputs without UI coupling, and test duplicates/updates.
Integrate model routing and provider health into a bounded fallback controller with one global wall-clock budget, cooldown awareness, cancellation, attempt ledger, and deterministic tests.

Build the Phase 1-2 application facade wiring rooms, chat orchestration, provider execution, model registry/router and persistence ports. Keep adapters injectable. Add vertical-slice tests: send→stream→stop→save→restore and fallback route.

Implement storage recovery and migration orchestration for rooms/settings required by Phase 1-2: atomic migrate-verify-commit, rollback, corruption quarantine metadata, interactive recovery actions model, and failure-injection tests.

Build platform-contract verification helpers and tests ensuring Phase 1-2 code depends only on typed ports, not window globals or direct Capacitor calls; include request/cancellation contract vectors for later Android adapter tests.

Build deterministic Phase 1-2 acceptance scenario definitions and reusable gate evaluator covering rooms persistence, streaming, stop, provider failure, fallback, restart restore and schema invariants. Add self-tests.

Build static/runtime architecture invariant checks for Phase 1-2: no mutable window Seven globals, no duplicate owners, no direct storage/provider calls from UI, no trailing system message, explicit cancellation ownership. Add tests.
